import json, subprocess, sys

def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return json.loads(p.stdout), p.stderr

BASE_MODEL = {
    "classes": 2, "embedding_dim": 1,
    "length_embedding": [[a] for a in range(16)],
    "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
    "kernel": 1,
    "conv_weights": [[[1, 0]]],
    "conv_bias": [0], "conv_shift": [0],
    "dense_weights": [[0], [1]], "dense_bias": [0, 0],
}

def cfg(**kw):
    c = {"slots": 1, "window": 1, "idle_timeout": 5, "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1,
         "rate_num": 1, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 8, "initial_tokens": 8,
         "pending_capacity": 8, "lanes": 1, "service": [1, 1], "fallback": 0,
         "time_edges": [0], "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]}
    c.update(kw)
    return c

# --- scenario C: idle timeout boundary + ties + applied cached class
docC = {"version": 1, "config": cfg(), "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
        "packets": [{"time": 0, "connection": "a", "length": 3, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 4, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 9, "connection": "a", "length": 1, "draw": 0}]}
out, err = run(docC)
expC = [(1, 0, "sent", 7, 0), (1, 1, "sent", 7, 1), (2, 0, "sent", 7, 2)]
gotC = [(p["generation"], p["forward"], p["decision"], p["credit"], p["job"]) for p in out["packets"]]
print("C packets:", "OK" if gotC == expC else ("FAIL %s != %s" % (gotC, expC)))
expJ = [(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, [[3, 0]], [0, 3], 1, "applied"),
        (1, 1, 0, 4, 5, [[0, 4]], [0, 0], 0, "applied"),
        (2, 2, 0, 9, 10, [[1, 0]], [0, 1], 1, "applied")]
gotJ = [(j["id"], j["packet"], j["start"], j["start"], j["done"], j["window"], j["logits"], j["prediction"], j["status"]) for j in out["jobs"]]
gotJ = [(j["id"], j["generation"], j["lane"], j["start"], j["done"], j["window"], j["logits"], j["prediction"], j["status"]) for j in out["jobs"]]
print("C jobs:", "OK" if gotJ == expJ else "FAIL\n got %s\n exp %s" % (gotJ, expJ))

# --- scenario D: superseded feedback via reordered lane completion
docD = {"version": 1,
        "config": cfg(idle_timeout=1000, lanes=2, service=[100, 1]),
        "model": {**BASE_MODEL, "dense_weights": [[64], [-64]], "dense_bias": [0, 64]},
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 1, "split": "eval"}],
        "packets": [{"time": 0, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 1, "connection": "a", "length": 10, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 2, "connection": "a", "length": 10, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 100, "connection": "a", "length": 10, "draw": 0}]}
out, err = run(docD)
print("D statuses:", [j["status"] for j in out["jobs"]],
      "expected ['superseded','applied','applied', ...]")
print("D jobs:", [(j["id"], j["lane"], j["start"], j["done"], j["prediction"], j["logits"]) for j in out["jobs"]])
print("D packets:", [(p["index"], p["forward"], p["decision"], p["credit"], p["job"]) for p in out["packets"]])

# --- scenario E: token bucket fractional rate + cap
docE = {"version": 1,
        "config": cfg(idle_timeout=1000, rate_num=1, rate_den=3, bucket_capacity=2, initial_tokens=1),
        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
        "packets": [{"time": t, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0} for t in [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 20]]}
out, err = run(docE)
print("E:", [(p["index"], p["decision"], p["credit"]) for p in out["packets"]])

# --- scenario F: probability bin edges
docF = {"version": 1,
        "config": cfg(idle_timeout=1000, time_edges=[0, 5, 10], count_edges=[0, 3],
                      probability=[[65536, 0], [100, 65536], [0, 0]]),
        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
        "packets": [{"time": t, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": d} for t, d in
                    [(0, 0), (1, 99), (2, 100), (3, 0), (5, 0), (6, 2), (10, 5), (11, 0), (30, 0)]]}
out, err = run(docF)
print("F:", [(p["index"], p["decision"]) for p in out["packets"]])

# --- scenario G: queue backpressure
docG = {"version": 1,
        "config": cfg(idle_timeout=1000, pending_capacity=2, service=[1000, 1000], lanes=1),
        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
        "packets": [{"time": t, "connection": "a", "length": 0, "draw": 0} for t in range(6)]}
out, err = run(docG)
print("G:", [(p["index"], p["decision"], p["job"]) for p in out["packets"]])
print("G statuses:", [j["status"] for j in out["jobs"]])

# --- scenario H: collisions with two connections in one slot
docH = {"version": 1, "config": cfg(idle_timeout=1000, slots=1, window=2),
        "model": BASE_MODEL,
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"},
                        {"id": "b", "slot": 0, "label": 1, "split": "eval"}],
        "packets": [{"time": 0, "connection": "a", "length": 1, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 1, "connection": "a", "length": 2, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 2, "connection": "b", "length": 3, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 3, "connection": "b", "length": 4, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 4, "connection": "a", "length": 5, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 5, "connection": "a", "length": 6, "draw": 0}]}
out, err = run(docH)
print("H packets:", [(p["index"], p["generation"], p["forward"], p["decision"]) for p in out["packets"]])
print("H jobs:", [(j["id"], j["connection"], j["generation"], j["status"], j["window"], j["prediction"]) for j in out["jobs"]])
print("H conns:", out["connections"])
print("H reports:", json.dumps(out["reports"]))
PYEOF
